# Tank Duel
A three.js tank game. index.html declares WebMCP tools (document.modelContext):
- describe: reads the full game state.
- pause: pauses or resumes real-time play.
- step: while paused, advances the simulation by n seconds.
- place: moves a tank to a legal spot.
- fire: fires a tank's shell.
- set_ai: turns the computer player on or off.
- reset: restarts the match.
